candidates.claim: OT-facing port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/5 is active in trunk mode, but OT-facing ports must be access ports in VLAN 10 and no trunk is approved on that port.
candidates.remediation: Return Gi1/0/5 to switchport mode access in VLAN 10 (or shut it down if unused) and confirm no trunk is required.

candidates.claim: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/5 on sw-ot-01 differs from the approved baseline: switchport mode is trunk in the current configuration but access in the baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change with the approved baseline, reverting to access mode unless the change is formally approved.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits tcp/443 from any source to fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2, although management access to fw-01 is permitted only from MGMT on the mgmt interface.
candidates.remediation: Remove the tcp/443 permit to 203.0.113.2 from EDGE_IN and confirm the ASA HTTP server is reachable only from MGMT on the mgmt interface.
